The '''''Tyed's Valiant''''' was a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] owned by [[Gryseium Incorporated]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents infected [[Sprawl 18]] with the [[Mynock II virus]], [[Sabel Axis Corazon]] personally pursued them in the ''Tyed's Valiant''.
